entries.en: Maybe I'll buy a new hand?
entries.ro: Poate îmi cumpăr o mână nouă?

entries.en: What do you mean, what…? Uh, I won…! You've never seen so much dough in one place… Uh, yeah…! I just got lucky!
entries.ro: Ce vrei să spui, ce…? Ăă, am câștigat…! N-ai mai văzut atâția bani într-un loc… Ăă, da…! Am avut noroc, atâta tot!

entries.en: Ten years and it finally paid off…! Fate! The first time…! I also couldn't believe it, hah!
entries.ro: Zece ani și în sfârșit a dat roade…! Soarta! Prima dată…! Nici eu nu-mi venea să cred, hah!

entries.en: Huhh... Is she still chasing me?!
entries.en_m: Huhh... Is he still chasing me?!

entries.en: I'll pay! Ye-- I have money!
Huhh, my life's only just begun!
entries.ro: Huhh, viața mea abia a început!

entries.en: I don't need company. Got what I need.
entries.ro: Nu am nevoie de companie. Am ce-mi trebuie.

entries.en: Why don't you just go away.
